from: Otherworld entrances (Darama / Zao / Svargrond glowing vortexes)

start.note: Otherworld, coords approx; endgame HoD quest area

note: ENDGAME (Heart of Destruction) — far above your level, included for completeness. The Otherworld is a shifting maze: 3 entrances, only ONE open at a time, passages change. A Spying Eye checks which of the 3 Glowing Vortexes is active. If lost: reach the Vortex Hub (safe area, coord ~125.162/122.96/11) and use a Temple Teleport, or backtrack via the hub routes.

steps.text: Enter via whichever Glowing Vortex is currently open (Darama / Zao / Svargrond). Begin at the orange STAR on each map, head to the green arrows (up/down) and red cross.
Route to the Vortex Hub depends on your entrance. The hub is reached after killing one of the 5 charge bosses.
Regardless of the active entrance, you can ALWAYS leave the hub via the path toward the Darama entrance (take the northern red exit vortex first).

hazard_note: Locations become unreachable when walls appear (one per entrance vortex); a yellow dot next to each wall = emergency exit if trapped.
